TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A post-apocalyptic landscape under a heavy blood-red and orange sky, with a cracked, weed-strewn road running from the foreground toward the horizon. On the left stand gutted multi-story apartment blocks with empty window openings and collapsed facades, while more ruined structures recede through the haze in the distance. At right, a rusted, tilted metal sign on a single post bears the word WELCOME, creating an ironic contrast with the devastation around it.
TEXT: WELCOME
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Night photograph of fireworks bursting above Red Square in Moscow, framed by Saint Basil's Cathedral with its colorful patterned onion domes on the left and the illuminated red-brick Spasskaya Tower of the Kremlin on the right. A dense crowd is silhouetted across the bottom of the frame, many holding up phones, while pink and violet smoke from the display drifts at ground level beneath the white and gold firework bursts.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: clock

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Vintage 1960s color photograph with rounded black corners showing a man resembling John F. Kennedy in dark sunglasses and a navy jacket standing on a ship's deck, exchanging an object with a young US Navy sailor in a dark blue uniform and white dixie-cup hat. A second sailor watches behind while a naval officer in a white peaked cap and dark coat stands at right facing away, with open blue ocean and a partly cloudy sky filling the background.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: water

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Street photograph of a hand-drawn wheat-paste poster taped to a grubby city utility pole: a large pink heart outlined in blue and red filled with blue marker lettering and two small red hearts, signed by the artist at the bottom. Behind it peel torn older posters including one with the visible word rebellion, and the blurred background shows a wet street with a white crosswalk and a dark car at left.
TEXT: THE GOOD TIMES WILL ROLL AGAIN @heartsny rebellion
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Close-up of a cylindrical red emergency beacon light mounted to a dark ceiling, glowing intensely and washing the pipes, wall, and floor below in a saturated crimson haze. The ribbed translucent lens of the fixture is the focal point against near-black shadows, giving the empty industrial-feeling space an alarm-like atmosphere.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: Cave-painting style artwork on a mottled ochre and tan rock surface depicting a prehistoric hunt: a dark-maned snarling big cat lunges at the center while a second orange lion with open jaws bounds below it, surrounded by leaping deer, a horse, and faint ghost-animal outlines. Red-ochre human handprints are pressed across the right side and lower edge, evoking Paleolithic wall art.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: screenshot
SUBJECT: Minimal teaser text card: a single line of bold white sans-serif lettering centered on a solid black background, reading like an announcement or hype message with the word BIG capitalized for emphasis. No other graphics, figures, or imagery appear in the frame.
TEXT: Something BIG is about to drop.
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: screenshot
SUBJECT: Screenshot of a verified Twitter/X post from the account Hillary Clinton (@HillaryClinton) reading Happy birthday to this future president, above a black-and-white childhood portrait of a smiling young girl with wavy hair and a dark hair ribbon wearing a white collared dress. A large red X drawn with two crossing red strokes overlays the photograph, and the post timestamp appears at the bottom of the capture.
TEXT: Hillary Clinton @HillaryClinton Follow Happy birthday to this future president. 9:03 AM · Oct 26, 2016
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Donald Trump in a dark blue suit and open-collar white shirt waves with raised hand to a packed outdoor crowd in front of a bright red doorway, flanked by a tall man in a dark apron and checked shirt holding a pink cap and a blonde woman smiling at his left. Supporters fill the foreground seen from behind, several wearing red campaign caps with white lettering and one green work cap, while phones are raised to photograph him; a Reuters watermark sits in the lower left corner.
TEXT: © REUTERS TRUMP MAKE (partial) GREAT (partial) 2024 (partial, green cap)
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: Courtroom illustration in pastel and ink showing a white-haired, bespectacled judge in black robes seated at a raised wooden bench on the left, while Donald Trump in a dark suit and blue tie sits in profile at the defense table on the right, mouth open as if speaking. A blue and yellow flag hangs on a pole between the two figures against a loosely washed tan and brown courtroom background.
